candidates.topic: Last Quarter Moon in Cancer — Emotional Audit
candidates.teaser: The Moon just shifted into Cancer at its Last Quarter phase — and what it's asking you to release might surprise you.
candidates.video_title: Last Quarter Moon in Cancer — Emotional Audit
candidates.video_description: The Last Quarter Moon in Cancer activates deep emotional release, especially with Mars also sitting in Cancer right now. Astrologers say this combination forces a reckoning with what you've been emotionally carrying. Are you ready to let it go?
candidates.script: The Moon is in Cancer right now — and it's at its Last Quarter, which in astrology is the phase of releasing, not receiving. But here's what makes this one different: Mars is also sitting in Cancer at 16 degrees. That's your emotional drive and your grief in the same room at the same time. Astrologers say this combination surfaces things you've been pushing down for weeks. Old resentments. Unspoken needs. The feelings you called 'fine.' What are you still carrying that this Moon is asking you to put down?

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — Conjunct Neptune Retrograde
candidates.teaser: Two retrograde planets are sitting within 10 degrees of each other in Aries right now — and astrologers say this hasn't happened in your lifetime.
candidates.video_title: Saturn and Neptune Both Retro in Aries — What That Means
candidates.video_description: Saturn sits at 13° Aries retrograde and Neptune at 3° Aries retrograde — both slowly moving closer in the same sign. Astrologers interpret this as a rare collision between structure and illusion, forcing a reality check on your biggest beliefs. This combination doesn't let you hide.
candidates.script: Saturn and Neptune are both retrograde in Aries right now — Saturn at 13 degrees, Neptune at 3. That's two of the slowest planets in the sky sitting in the same sign at the same time, both moving backwards. In astrology, Saturn is your structure, your discipline, your rules. Neptune is your dreams, your illusions, the stories you tell yourself. When they share a sign in retrograde, astrologers say the things you built on false foundations start to crack. Which version of your life is real — and which one did you just convince yourself to believe?

candidates.topic: Pluto Retrograde in Aquarius — Power Structures Turning Inward
candidates.teaser: Pluto has been retrograde in Aquarius all year — and most people have no idea what it's quietly dismantling.
candidates.video_title: Pluto Retro in Aquarius — What It's Secretly Dismantling
candidates.video_description: Pluto retrograde in Aquarius at 3.4° turns the planet of transformation inward, away from collective systems and toward personal power dynamics. Astrologers say this transit exposes where you've been giving your power away to groups, ideologies, or technology. The revolution starts inside.
candidates.script: Pluto is retrograde in Aquarius right now — and in astrology, when Pluto goes backward, the transformation stops happening out there and starts happening in here. Aquarius rules systems, communities, technology, the collective. So Pluto retrograde here forces a personal question: where have you handed your power over to a group, a platform, an ideology — and called it belonging? Astrologers say this retrograde period strips away the identity you borrowed from others. The version of you that nobody assigned you — that's what Pluto is trying to find. Are you ready for that?

candidates.topic: The Astrological 4th House — Your Hidden Roots
candidates.teaser: Your 4th house is the most private part of your birth chart — and it reveals something about you that your Sun sign never could.
candidates.video_title: The 4th House — The Most Private Part of Your Chart
candidates.video_description: The 4th house in astrology rules home, roots, family lineage, and your private emotional foundation. Whatever sign sits on your 4th house cusp reveals the invisible blueprint shaping how you feel safe — or unsafe — in the world. It's the part of you most people never see.
candidates.script: The 4th house in your birth chart is the part of you that nobody sees — not even people close to you. In astrology it rules your roots: your childhood home, your family lineage, the emotional patterns passed down before you could speak. The sign on your 4th house cusp tells astrologers what you need to feel truly safe, and most of the time, it's the opposite of how you present yourself to the world. Your Sun sign is your performance. Your 4th house is the room you go back to when the performance is over. Do you even know what sign rules yours?

candidates.topic: Venus in Libra — Approaching Retrograde Shadow
candidates.teaser: Venus is in Libra right now at nearly 27 degrees — and what comes next for your relationships is already being written.
candidates.video_title: Venus in Libra at 27° — What's Coming for Relationships
candidates.video_description: Venus sits at 26.7° Libra right now, the sign it rules, operating at full relational power. Astrologers say Venus in its home sign heightens the need for balance, beauty, and fairness in relationships — but also exposes where those things are missing. Pay attention to what feels unequal right now.
candidates.script: Venus is at 26 degrees Libra right now — its own sign, which means it's operating at full power. In astrology, Venus in Libra doesn't just want love, it wants love that's fair, balanced, and beautiful in structure. But here's the thing: when Venus is this strong, it also makes imbalance unbearable. Anything in your relationships that's been quietly off — the uneven effort, the unspoken resentment, the deal you settled for — Venus at this degree puts it directly in your face. What are you still pretending is balanced when you already know it isn't?
